summary: This DeepSeek Harness web plugin adds a Files panel to conversations so you can browse workspace files, pick code snippets or whole files, and automatically attach the selected content as context when sending a message.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a workspace context-selection tool for DeepSeek Harness conversations: it adds a Files tab with a file tree and viewer, lets users pick code snippets or whole files, and automatically injects those selections into outgoing message context. Evidence in the README and package manifest shows no code-generation, execution, or external service integration, but it does expose file read/list behavior through same-origin host endpoints, so its main risk is controlled local file-read context sharing rather than system modification.
